option_relations.rationale: The option describes acute coronary syndrome, which is ruled out by coronary angiography showing nonobstructive disease and the patient's troponin levels being unchanged from baseline. The leaf describes metastatic lung cancer to the myocardium and pericardium, which is a different disease process.

The option describes ST-segment elevation due to myocardial metastasis from squamous cell carcinoma of the lung. The leaf describes metastatic lung cancer to the myocardium and pericardium. The ST-segment elevation is a manifestation of the myocardial metastasis described in the leaf.

The option describes cardiac metastasis from lung cancer (intracardiac mass). The leaf describes metastatic lung cancer to the myocardium (left ventricular mass) and pericardium. The option is a broader category that includes the specific metastatic location described in the leaf.

The option describes metastatic cardiac tumor (secondary to lung cancer). The leaf describes metastatic lung cancer to the myocardium and pericardium. The option is a broader category that includes the specific metastatic location described in the leaf.
